rationale: C01 is a highly plausible drafting template. Both memoranda reject private tax-refund legislation because the claimant missed a statutory filing deadline, proceed through the same factual and policy sequence, and share several nearly verbatim sentences concerning the absence of justification, finality in tax administration, discrimination against similarly situated taxpayers, undesirable precedent, and the concluding withholding of approval. C12 and C10 contain closely related standardized passages, but C01 provides the most extensive and specific match to the child's language and structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The record in this case discloses no justification for the failure to file a claim until June 1956.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The record on this bill does not disclose any special circumstance, justifying the taxpayer's failure to file a timely claim.
shared_material.explanation: Both introduce the policy analysis with a case-specific finding that nothing justifies the untimely refund claim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The statute of limitations, which the Congress has included in the revenue system as a matter of sound policy, is essential in order to achieve finality in tax administration.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The statutory period of limitations, which the Congress has included in the revenue system as a matter of sound policy, is essential in order to achieve finality in tax administration.
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive near-verbatim shared language articulating the central administrative rationale.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Granting special relief in this case, where a refund was not claimed in the time and manner prescribed by law, would discriminate against other similarly situated taxpayers and would create an undesirable precedent.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Granting special relief in this case, where a refund was not claimed in the time and manner prescribed by law, would constitute a discrimination against other taxpayers similarly situated and would create an undesirable precedent.
shared_material.explanation: The operative objection is reproduced almost word for word, with only minor grammatical changes.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Under the circumstances, therefore, I am constrained to withhold my approval of the bill.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Under the circumstances, therefore, I am constrained to withhold my approval of the bill.
shared_material.explanation: The conclusions are identical and cap the same sequence of reasons.
